formula.arms: control is unbound (never approved) and runs until the plan has no review blockers; risk is bound, is approved once as a sandbox and then elaborates its at-launch stages until none is pending
formula.stop_reason: forced = an agent override stands; elaborated = bound, approved, no lazy stage pending; admissible = no blocker and not (bound and approved); cap = the run stopped before the arm reached its condition (cap is the review-act budget the run was given)
formula.review_acts: counted acts (lib.review_cycles.is_act) before the first approve event are to_admissible, after it deferred; an arm that never approved has no deferred acts
formula.thinker_spawn_h: spawn-cost ledger rows of kind thinker whose spawner_session (else session_id) is the arm's session, duration_ms / 3.6e6, split at the ts of the first approve event
formula.late_r: concerns the classifier put on axis R that were raised after the first approve event
formula.judge_r_v: defects of axes R and V the blind judge found in the plan rendered by judge-view
formula.faster: the risk arm's total review acts AND thinker spawn-hours are each <= 50 percent of control's
formula.quality_held: the risk arm's judge R+V defects <= control's
formula.verdict: inconclusive unless control stopped admissible and risk stopped elaborated and both comparisons are defined; then pass when faster and quality held, else fail

rows: review round budget exhausted at round 7 (the task's review_rounds count against config.md's effort-replan-absolute threshold, reused) — a whole-plan or stage thinker PASS was already recorded this approval cycle, and a recorded pass is terminal: 'run a fresh whole-plan thinker review' is no longer an exit, because an on-budget pass would have cleared the gate directly rather than reaching this message at all. The decision is the coordinator's and must be recorded. Two exits, both executable from this state, in the order to try them: (1) the reflection exit — run the overcome-difficulty cycle on why the review loop did not converge (declare, investigate, critique naming differences_to_remove, then normalize with a real factor, not a waiver), then act on that critique by editing the plan as the concern proposes (cut or add) and re-applying it by the route your state allows; or (2) last, go ahead with the plan as it stands, without a further review, by running plan-review --verdict override --reviewer <you> --note <why it is acceptable> — an agent-authored override is admitted only with the reflection exit's record: a complete difficulty record declared after this release, with differences_to_remove and a real normalization, which the override then consumes. Re-apply an edited plan by the route your state allows — `submit-plan` before approval, `replan --plan <edited>` after it — but the budget does not refill, so editing the plan does not by itself open this gate; `approve` still answers to every other gate as well
